apply_update.note: SSH-free health-gated redeploy via the ops-hook. Grant-gated install.

check_for_update.note: Resolve running version against admin /v1/fleet-versions — wire when the cell is seeded into the fleet manifest.

enter_safe_mode.note: No runtime mode to toggle on this control plane.

reconnect.note: DB pool self-heals; the edge is stateless KV — nothing to manually reconnect.

reset_to_defaults.note: Sites hold real user content — there is no safe factory-reset.

restart_app.note: Out-of-band: needs the host ops-hook (systemd unit outside the container, bearer + confirm nonce) — Grant-gated install per host.
